# what: why the published Compiler Explorer link has no Clang pane
# how:  scripts/triage.py's ce_compile(), called directly (see the command lines
#       below); CE compiler id hlsl_clang_trunk, Release Linux build
# when: 2026-08-07
# note: NOT a probe of this issue's predicate. Clang output here is evidence about
#       Clang's raytracing support, not about the empty payload.

SKILL.md step 7 says to consider a Clang pane, and that "a Clang error is not
evidence until you have a control". Both were run.

==============================================================================
==== repro.hlsl -- the reported shader (empty payload)
==============================================================================
$ hlsl_clang_trunk -T lib_6_3
exit=1
clang: warning: argument unused during compilation: '-Qembed_debug' [-Wunused-command-line-argument]
<source>:2:42: error: semantic annotations must be present for all parameters of an entry function or patch constant function
    2 | [shader("miss")] void main(inout Payload payload) {}
      |                                          ^
<source>:2:42: note: 'payload' declared here
1 error generated.
<Compilation failed>

==============================================================================
==== control-nonempty-payload.hlsl -- CONTROL: identical shader, payload has one
==== float4 field. DXC compiles this for both targets (see
==== variant-control-nonempty-main-debug.txt).
==============================================================================
$ hlsl_clang_trunk -T lib_6_3
exit=1
clang: warning: argument unused during compilation: '-Qembed_debug' [-Wunused-command-line-argument]
<source>:2:42: error: semantic annotations must be present for all parameters of an entry function or patch constant function
    2 | [shader("miss")] void main(inout Payload payload) {}
      |                                          ^
<source>:2:42: note: 'payload' declared here
1 error generated.
<Compilation failed>

==============================================================================
==== conclusion
==============================================================================
The control fails identically, so Clang's error is about raytracing entry points
in general -- its HLSL front end does not yet model a payload parameter and demands
a semantic annotation on it -- and says nothing about empty payloads. -fsyntax-only
changes nothing: this is a Sema error, so the back end never runs (the extra output
is only an unused '-S' warning).

A pane of that would be noise about the stage, so the Clang pane is omitted. It also
means the "has the successor compiler already answered this?" question cannot be
asked here yet: Clang cannot express the input at all.
